name: kicad-cli
description: KiCad 10.0.4 command line interface: schematic/PCB checks and exports.

format.description: Version info format: plain, commit, or about. Default plain.

tools.name: sch_erc
tools.description: Run the Electrical Rules Check (ERC) on a KiCad schematic (.kicad_sch) and write a report.

input_file.description: Path to the schematic file (.kicad_sch) to check.

output.description: Path to write the ERC report to.

format.description: Report format: json or report. Default report.

units.description: Units used in the report: in, mm, or mils. Default mm.

severity_all.description: Report all ERC violation severities (errors, warnings, and exclusions).

exit_code_violations.description: Return a nonzero exit code if any ERC violations exist.

tools.name: pcb_drc
tools.description: Run the Design Rules Check (DRC) on a KiCad PCB (.kicad_pcb) and write a report.

input_file.description: Path to the PCB file (.kicad_pcb) to check.

output.description: Path to write the DRC report to.

format.description: Report format: json or report. Default report.

units.description: Units used in the report: in, mm, or mils. Default mm.

severity_all.description: Report all DRC violation severities (errors, warnings, and exclusions).

exit_code_violations.description: Return a nonzero exit code if any DRC violations exist.

schematic_parity.description: Also test for parity between the PCB and its schematic.

all_track_errors.description: Report all errors for each track, not just the first.

tools.name: sch_export_pdf
tools.description: Export a KiCad schematic (.kicad_sch) to a single PDF file.

input_file.description: Path to the schematic file (.kicad_sch) to export.

output.description: Path to write the exported PDF file.

black_and_white.description: Render the PDF in black and white only.

exclude_drawing_sheet.description: Omit the drawing sheet (title block and border) from the export.

pages.description: Comma separated list of page numbers to export. Blank or unspecified exports all pages.

tools.name: sch_export_svg
tools.description: Export a KiCad schematic (.kicad_sch) to SVG files, one per sheet, into an output directory.

input_file.description: Path to the schematic file (.kicad_sch) to export.

output.description: Path to the output directory for exported SVG files.

black_and_white.description: Render the SVG in black and white only.

exclude_drawing_sheet.description: Omit the drawing sheet (title block and border) from the export.

pages.description: Comma separated list of page numbers to export. Blank or unspecified exports all pages.

tools.name: sch_export_netlist
tools.description: Export a netlist from a KiCad schematic (.kicad_sch).

input_file.description: Path to the schematic file (.kicad_sch) to export.

output.description: Path to write the netlist file.

format.description: Netlist format: kicadsexpr, kicadxml, cadstar, orcadpcb2, spice, spicemodel, pads, or allegro. Default kicadsexpr.

tools.name: sch_export_bom
tools.description: Generate a Bill of Materials (BOM) from a KiCad schematic (.kicad_sch).

input_file.description: Path to the schematic file (.kicad_sch) to export.

output.description: Path to write the BOM file.

fields.description: Ordered comma separated list of fields to export, e.g. Reference,Value,Footprint,QUANTITY,DNP.

group_by.description: Comma separated list of fields to group references by when their values match.

tools.name: pcb_export_gerbers
tools.description: Plot Gerber files for a KiCad PCB (.kicad_pcb) into an output directory.

input_file.description: Path to the PCB file (.kicad_pcb) to export.

output.description: Path to the output directory for Gerber files.

layers.description: Comma separated list of untranslated layer names to include, e.g. F.Cu,B.Cu. Default is all copper and technical layers.

use_drill_file_origin.description: Use the drill/place file origin instead of absolute coordinates.

tools.name: pcb_export_drill
tools.description: Generate drill files for a KiCad PCB (.kicad_pcb) into an output directory.

input_file.description: Path to the PCB file (.kicad_pcb) to export.

output.description: Path to the output directory for drill files.

format.description: Drill file format: excellon or gerber. Default excellon.

excellon_units.description: Output units for Excellon files: in or mm. Default mm.

generate_map.description: Also generate a map/summary of drill hits.

tools.name: pcb_export_pdf
tools.description: Plot a KiCad PCB (.kicad_pcb) to PDF for the given layers.

input_file.description: Path to the PCB file (.kicad_pcb) to export.

layers.description: Comma separated list of untranslated layer names to plot, e.g. F.Cu,B.Cu. At least one layer is required by kicad-cli.

output.description: Output directory for the exported PDF (an exact file path only if mode-single behavior applies).

black_and_white.description: Render the PDF in black and white only.

mirror.description: Mirror the board, useful for showing bottom layers.

tools.name: pcb_export_svg
tools.description: Plot a KiCad PCB (.kicad_pcb) to SVG for the given layers.

input_file.description: Path to the PCB file (.kicad_pcb) to export.

layers.description: Comma separated list of untranslated layer names to plot, e.g. F.Cu,B.Cu. At least one layer is required by kicad-cli.

output.description: Path to the output directory for exported SVG files.

black_and_white.description: Render the SVG in black and white only.

mirror.description: Mirror the board, useful for showing bottom layers.

tools.name: pcb_export_step
tools.description: Export a KiCad PCB (.kicad_pcb) to a STEP 3D model file.

input_file.description: Path to the PCB file (.kicad_pcb) to export.

output.description: Path to write the exported STEP file.

force.description: Overwrite the output file if it already exists.

board_only.description: Only generate the board body, without component 3D models.

subst_models.description: Substitute STEP or IGS models in place of VRML models where available.

no_dnp.description: Exclude 3D models for components marked Do-Not-Populate.

tools.name: pcb_export_pos
tools.description: Generate a component position (pick-and-place) file from a KiCad PCB (.kicad_pcb).

input_file.description: Path to the PCB file (.kicad_pcb) to export.

output.description: Path to write the position file.

side.description: Which side to include: front, back, or both. Default both. Gerber format only supports front or back.

format.description: Position file format: ascii, csv, or gerber. Default ascii.

units.description: Output units for ascii/csv format: in or mm. Default in.
